tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have supplied Security Guards persons of total 10 Nos to Govt/ Semi Govt/ULB through outsource for a minimum period of 1 (One) year in the last Five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26.
Attested copy of EPF certificate from Regional Provident Fund Commissioner regarding successful payment of EPF for the year 2023-2024, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to be enclosed
Attested copy of ESI Registration Certificate from ESI Deputy Director regarding successful payment of ESI for the year 2023-2024, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to be enclosed.
Attested copy of payment details towards Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund for the year 2025 on or before 15-01-2026. FORM D(Rule 3-A)
Attested copy of Professional Tax Registration Certificate Teeruvalli Certificate for the year 2023-2024, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to be enclosed.

Copy of GST Registration Certificate of agency/organization and for the year 2023-2024, 2024-25 & 2025-26 list of service provided to different Govt department or non-government departments/office with values. Further enclose a copy of monthly GST returns and schedules of TDS deducted from different departments/offices along with GST paid challans matched against those TDS deducted by different departments/offices.(copies to been closed)

The Bidder should provide the financial capability based on its own financial statements. Financial capability of the Bidders parent company or its subsidiary or any associate company will not be considered for computation of the financial capability of the Bidder (Proof of copies shall be Enclosed).

To qualify for award of the contract, each bidder in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26.i.Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of minimum Rs.25.00 Lakhs ii.Mandatory satisfactory completion as a prime successful bidder for at least one similar nature of work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work i.e.Minimum Rs 10 Lakhs
Last Five Years IT returns and Financial Turn Over certified from CA i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26.
Financial Offers of only those Bidders, who qualify as per the above parameters, would be opened (Proof copies to be Enclosed).
